title: Capsule-Wardrobe Coverage Score
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wardrobe:item capsule=yes
| stats dc(category) as categories, count as items by season
| eval coverage_score=round(items/categories,1)
| sort - coverage_score
description: Measures whether your capsule wardrobe has enough pieces across categories for each season without bloat.
value: Capsules fail when they are either too thin to be practical or too large to be intentional; coverage score catches both.
implementation: Flag capsule items in `wardrobe:item`; compare item count and category coverage by season.
visualization: Table of seasons with capsule coverage score.
grandmaExplanation: It warns whether your capsule wardrobe is practical for each season without getting bloated.
